data.description:
## Context
Completion verification for b42a found that the shipped Mode enum, MODE_CAPS mapping, and reconcile-check phase-gate value remain present, but the acceptance criterion over-attributed their direct coverage to test_mode.py and test_advisory_lock.py. The change is already merged; add focused characterization coverage without changing production behavior.

## Approach
- Extend the existing mode contract suite to pin the complete MODE_CAPS mapping, including RECONCILE_CHECK=0 and every legacy mode cap.
- Extend the existing ref-backed advisory-lock phase-gate test to write and read the exact reconcile-check value and prove higher modes block while the equal reconcile-check target remains allowed.
- Keep all old mode values, ordering, caps, and gate storage unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_mode.py directly asserts the complete MODE_CAPS mapping for all five legacy modes.
- [ ] tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock.py round-trips gated_mode reconcile-check through the real ref backend and proves equal-versus-higher blocking behavior.
- [ ] No production file changes.
- [ ] Focused tests, make lint, and make typecheck pass.

## Compatibility and rollback
This is additive characterization coverage only. Reverting the test commit restores the prior coverage level without changing runtime state.
data.title: Pin legacy reconciler mode-cap and phase-gate continuity
